gloss: presenter (of an award or a talk)

definitions.gloss: presenter (of an award, a TV segment or a talk)
definitions.explanation: A person who hands out an award at a ceremony, introduces a segment, or gives a presentation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{授賞式|じゅしょうしき}→授賞式：24267_jushoushiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧プレゼンター⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{務|つと}める→務める：10446_tsutomeru⟧。
examples.english: To act as a presenter at an awards ceremony.

examples.japanese: ⟦{次|つぎ}→次：00819_tsugi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧プレゼンター⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{田中|たなか}→田中：09528_tanaka⟧さんです。
examples.english: The next presenter is Ms. Tanaka.

examples.japanese: ⟦{映画祭|えいがさい}→映画祭：30642_eigasai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な⟦{俳優|はいゆう}→俳優：03547_haiyuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧プレゼンター⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{登場|とうじょう}→登場：13625_toujou⟧し、⟦{受賞者|じゅしょうしゃ}→受賞者：24174_jushousha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧トロフィー⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{手渡|てわた}した→手渡す：12757_tewatasu⟧。
examples.english: At the film festival, a famous actor appeared as presenter and handed the trophy to the winner.

notes:
From English "presenter".

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- プレゼンター⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{務|つと}める→務める：10446_tsutomeru⟧: to serve as presenter
- ⟦{授賞式|じゅしょうしき}→授賞式：24267_jushoushiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧プレゼンター: the presenter at an awards ceremony

WATCH OUT:
The host of a TV program, the British "TV presenter", is usually ⟦{司会者|しかいしゃ}→司会者：20470_shikaisha⟧ or ⟦キャスター→キャスター：27958_kyasutaa⟧ in Japanese. For the speaker at a meeting, ⟦{発表者|はっぴょうしゃ}→発表者：25562_happyousha⟧ is the more formal word.
